picks.name: DJ Python
picks.source_note: Already in your library. Full EP now out -- previously featured the lead single "Forgetful Angel" on Oct 8 as a preview; this is the complete 5-track release.
picks.bio: "to accomplish many things" (October 23, 2026, XL Recordings) is DJ Python's companion EP to 2025's "i was put on this earth" -- five tracks moving through reggaeton, ambient, deep house, trip-hop, shoegaze and pop, with guest vocals from ari, Tony Bontana and EDEN.
picks.why_listen: The dreamy, vocal-led follow-through on a single you already picked -- "Honey Bee" and "Mi Fai Sorridere" widen the EP past the lead single into warmer, pop-adjacent territory, good for a reflective stretch of a set.
